loreBoost.Name: Lore-Collector advantage
loreBoost.Hint: How much likelier a Lore-Collector's rolls against a foe it has sized up are to succeed, through its next turn, after spending its action on the Study action (when the check worked; never without it). 1.25× is a nudge, 3× a sure thing more often than not. Default 2.5×: Study takes the whole turn, and works only a little over half the time. Ordinary attacks already hit often, and the dice stop a roll near 95%, so above about 1.75× little changes for them; the rest helps long-shot rolls (a hard AC, a hard talk).
